LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Compact "My Tasks" panel for a sidebar column. Interactive completion checkbox, filter dropdown, auto-grouping by Overdue / Today / Tomorrow / This week / Later, optional quick actions, and "New task" shortcut.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls all built-in UI strings (headings, buttons, groups, filters). Explicit values set on cardTitle / emptyStateMessage still override the dictionary.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default (‘My Tasks’ / ‘Mes tâches’).

property.name: defaultFilter
property.label: Default filter
property.description: One of the values in 'Filter options' - use the English key (Today / Mine / Overdue / Upcoming / Completed). The UI translates the key to the active language's label.

property.name: filterOptionsCsv
property.label: Filter options (comma-separated keys)
property.description: Built-in keys get translated automatically. Any other value is shown verbatim.

property.name: showQuickActions
property.label: Show quick actions on hover
property.description: Reveals Log-a-Call / Email buttons when hovering a row.

property.name: emptyStateMessage
property.label: Empty-state message (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default.
